retrievalProfile.description: A split-screen layout featuring two distinct photographic subjects separated by a diagonal axis with bold, condensed sans-serif typography angled to match the composition.

recipe.visualDefinition: A black background divided into two primary zones by a diagonal tilt, featuring rectangular photographic inserts and high-contrast, condensed sans-serif text that follows the upward diagonal slant of the composition.
coreVisualRelationships: Diagonal alignment between text blocks and image borders
High contrast between vibrant text colors and black background
Symmetrical split between two distinct photographic subjects
Tight, vertical stacking of tracklist metadata
coreInvariants: Diagonal text orientation following a consistent upward angle

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two rectangular photographs placed in opposite corners (top-right and bottom-left), occupying approximately 40% of the frame each.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bold, colored display text for the primary subjects acts as the anchor for each half.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows a Z-pattern, starting at the top-left text, moving through the first image, down to the second text block, and ending at the second image.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Solid black background fills the central diagonal gutter and the corners not occupied by imagery.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright yellow and vibrant green for primary display typography.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White for secondary tracklist text and metadata.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation for primary text against a zero-value background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-condensed sans-serif with uniform stroke weight.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Uniform typeface family using weight and color to distinguish hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, sans-serif feel of the display text.
Provides the necessary verticality and mid-century industrial feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a black canvas with two rectangular photo placeholders: one in the top right and one in the bottom left, slightly tilted to follow an 8-degree upward diagonal axis.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two blocks of uppercase, extra-condensed sans-serif text. The top block should be yellow and tilted 8 degrees upward. The bottom block should be green and tilted 8 degrees upward. Add white tracklists in a smaller condensed font below each header.

verificationChecks: Is the display text tilted at an upward angle?
Are the colors yellow, green, and white?

adjustableVariables: Saturation of the yellow and green hues
mustRedesign: Specific band names and track titles

avoid: Horizontal text on a diagonal layout

postGenerationChecks: Check that text does not overlap the photographic subjects.
Ensure the diagonal angle is consistent across all elements.
Verify that all text is in uppercase.
Confirm the background is pure black.
recipe.reuseFormula: Black background + diagonal split + condensed sans-serif headers in primary colors + white metadata lists.
